output.one_liner: Consensus is an AI search engine that searches over 400 million scholarly articles and writes evidence-based answers linking to peer-reviewed research papers.

auth.notes: API key self-serve generation through user dashboard. OAuth2 used for MCP and third-party integrations. Specific OAuth grant type not documented.

evidence.snippet: To get a key, click your profile icon in Consensus, choose API & MCP Dashboard, open Keys and Clients, and click New key
OAuth will open in your browser automatically on first use.

access.notes: Free Consensus account includes API access with unlimited paper searches. Full-text excerpts and advanced features require paid plans (Pro, Deep, Teams, Enterprise).

evidence.snippet: It's self-serve and open to everyone.
A Consensus account is required and free to create.
Paper search is unlimited on every plan.

api_surface.rate_limit_note: Rate limits not documented in provided pages

evidence.snippet: Search Consensus for research papers with study, publication, and access filters

buildability.rationale: Self-serve API key generation, fully documented REST API, and official MCP server enable toolkit development today; Composio already has an existing toolkit.

overview_evidence.snippet: Consensus is an AI search engine for research. You ask a question, it searches over 400 million scholarly articles
Consensus provides evidence-based search across scientific research papers.

unknown_reasons.api_surface: OpenAPI spec URL not provided; webhook support not documented
